## Objective

Phase 4 of `planning/gfw_analysis_plan.qmd`: estimate how the **gradient of
fishing effort with distance from the leases** changed between the stages
(Before–After–Gradient, Methratta 2020, 2021), and how effort responded to
each foundation's installation, its 500 m safety zone and active
construction.

| Step | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | Descriptive BAG: rate by distance band × stage (season-standardised) and × stage × season, with cell-bootstrap intervals |
| 2 | Event time: monthly rate by band around each project's first foundation, season-adjusted, with bootstrap intervals |
| 3 | Simulation power: the minimum detectable BAG effect (MDE) per dataset × gear |
| 4 | Pre-trend equivalence test (TOST), with margins from step 3 |
| 5 | Stage × season BAG per dataset × gear |
| 6 | Timing BAG with the Ørsted covariates (foundation distance, construction, safety zones) |
| 7 | Formal mobile vs fixed contrast |
| 8 | Rate ratios with MDEs, predicted densities, diagnostics, leave-one-vessel-out, fleet-size sensitivity |

**Interim models (decision 2026-10-20, D-047).** Phase 5 chooses the final
spatial structure and families. Until then every model here uses the form
Phase 5 recommends: `sdmTMB` with an SPDE spatial field (mesh cutoff
`r params$mesh_cutoff_km` km), NB2 for vessel presence (VP) and Tweedie for
apparent fishing effort (AFE, with delta-Gamma alongside for the stage ×
season models). Everything is cached with `fit_cached()`, so Phase 5 can
refit with its choices by changing the specification only.

**Domains** (caveat 13). Each dataset × gear is modelled on the cells it
used in Stage 1 (`domain`), so cells that were never fished before
construction (structural zeros) do not dilute the contrast, and the domain
cannot depend on the outcome. Pole-and-line AFE is not modelled (plan,
"Scope per gear"); it appears in the descriptive steps only.

**Reading the results.** Every BAG effect is a rate ratio: the change in a
band's rate since Stage 1, **relative to the 8–15 km ring**. It measures
**redistribution** within the study area, not a net change in regional
effort (plan, "Limits of the within-AOI BAG"). Each estimate is reported
next to its gear's MDE, so a null reads "no effect larger than the MDE".

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(sf)
  library(sdmTMB)
  library(DHARMa)
})

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")
source("r/bag_helpers.R")

qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(file.path(root, "r/10_bag.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)

set.seed(42)

fig_dir <- file.path(paths$bag, "figures")
tab_dir <- file.path(paths$bag, "tables")
job_dir <- file.path(paths$bag, "cache")
for (d in c(fig_dir, tab_dir, job_dir)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

outputs <- character()
save_tab <- function(df, name) {
  f <- file.path(tab_dir, paste0(name, ".csv"))
  write_csv(df, f, na = "")
  outputs <<- c(outputs, f)
  invisible(f)
}
save_fig <- function(p, name, width = 10, height = 6) {
  f <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png"))
  ggsave(f, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
  outputs <<- c(outputs, f)
  invisible(p)
}
kable_round <- function(df, digits = 3) {
  df |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, digits))) |> knitr::kable()
}
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))

datasets <- c("vp", "afe")
ds_label <- c(vp = "VP", afe = "AFE")
gear_cols <- c(MOBILE = "#2a78d6", FIXED = "#eb6834", POLE_AND_LINE = "#1baf7a")
stage_cols <- c("Stage 1" = "#86b6ef", "Stage 2" = "#2a78d6", "Stage 3" = "#0d366b")
```

## Read the Phase 0 tables

```{r}
tpath <- \(ds, ts) file.path(paths$analysis, sprintf("%s_%s_gear.csv", ds, ts))
read_tab <- \(ds, ts) read_csv(tpath(ds, ts), show_col_types = FALSE,
                               col_types = cols(cell_id = "c", gear_class = "c", stage = "c",
                                                season = "c", phase = "c", dist_band = "c",
                                                nearest_project = "c", domain = "l", .default = "?"))
ss    <- map(set_names(datasets), \(ds) read_tab(ds, "stage_season"))
st    <- map(set_names(datasets), \(ds) read_tab(ds, "stage"))
month <- map(set_names(datasets), \(ds) read_tab(ds, "month"))
sy_afe <- read_tab("afe", "season_year")
# VP season-year is read only for its fleet counts (the fleet-size sensitivity
# for fixed AFE, whose timing model runs at season-year)
sy_vp <- read_tab("vp", "season_year")

input_files <- c(map(datasets, \(ds) tpath(ds, c("stage", "stage_season", "month"))) |> unlist(),
                 tpath(c("afe", "vp"), "season_year"))

# the modelled dataset × gear combinations (plan, "Scope per gear")
ss_models <- tribble(~dataset, ~gear,
                     "vp", "MOBILE", "vp", "FIXED", "vp", "POLE_AND_LINE",
                     "afe", "MOBILE", "afe", "FIXED") |>
  mutate(id = paste(dataset, gear, sep = "_"),
         family = if_else(dataset == "vp", "nbinom2", "tweedie"))
ss_models |> knitr::kable()
```

## Step 1: descriptive BAG

The rate by distance band in each stage (season-standardised, caveat 8: the
mean of the 12 month-of-year rates, so stages with different calendar mixes
compare fairly), and in each stage × season. Intervals resample cells within
each band (`r qparams$n_boot` draws). All cells, all three gears.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
# plotting order; near (inside + 0–2) and mid (2–8 km) are the merged
# scheme's bands (D-076)
band_order <- c("inside", "0-2", "near", "2-4", "4-8", "mid", "8-15")
desc_stage <- map_dfr(set_names(datasets), function(ds) {
  st[[ds]] |>
    transmute(gear_class, stage, dist_band, hours = rate_std, expo = area_km2) |>
    group_by(gear_class, stage) |>
    group_modify(\(g, k) boot_band_rate(g, B = qparams$n_boot)) |> ungroup()
}, .id = "dataset") |>
  mutate(dist_band = factor(dist_band, band_order))
desc_ss <- map_dfr(set_names(datasets), function(ds) {
  ss[[ds]] |>
    transmute(gear_class, stage, season, dist_band, hours, expo = months * area_km2) |>
    group_by(gear_class, stage, season) |>
    group_modify(\(g, k) boot_band_rate(g, B = qparams$n_boot)) |> ungroup()
}, .id = "dataset") |>
  mutate(dist_band = factor(dist_band, band_order))
save_tab(desc_stage, "bag_descriptive_stage")
save_tab(desc_ss, "bag_descriptive_stage_season")

gradient_plot <- function(d, title) {
  ggplot(d, aes(dist_band, rate, colour = stage, group = stage)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), size = 0.25, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = stage_cols) +
    labs(x = "distance band (km from the nearest lease; inside = within a lease)",
         y = "hours per km² per month", colour = NULL, title = title)
}
p <- gradient_plot(desc_stage, "Effort gradient by stage (season-standardised; 95% cell-bootstrap intervals)") +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ gear_class, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(dataset = ds_label))
save_fig(p, "bag_descriptive_stage", height = 7)
p

for (ds in datasets) {
  p <- gradient_plot(filter(desc_ss, dataset == ds),
                     paste(ds_label[[ds]], "effort gradient by stage, within each season")) +
    facet_grid(season ~ gear_class, scales = "free_y")
  save_fig(p, sprintf("bag_descriptive_stage_season_%s", ds), height = 7)
  print(p)
}
```

The descriptive BAG ratio: each band's rate divided by the 8–15 km ring's,
by stage. Its change from Stage 1 is what the models estimate.

```{r}
desc_ratio <- desc_stage |>
  group_by(dataset, gear_class, stage) |>
  mutate(ratio_to_ring = rate / rate[dist_band == "8-15"]) |> ungroup() |>
  select(dataset, gear_class, stage, dist_band, ratio_to_ring) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = stage, values_from = ratio_to_ring)
save_tab(desc_ratio, "bag_descriptive_ratio_to_ring")
desc_ratio |> filter(dist_band %in% c("inside", "0-2")) |> kable_round(2)
```

## Step 2: event time

Monthly density per cell around each project's first foundation
(`months_since_first_found`, −`r qparams$event_window` to
+`r qparams$event_window`), by distance band and nearest project. Season is
removed by dividing each value by its dataset × gear × band's month-of-year
index (that month's mean over the whole series, relative to the overall
mean). Intervals resample cells (199 draws, enough for a plotted band).

```{r}
#| fig-height: 9
event <- map_dfr(set_names(datasets), function(ds) {
  m <- month[[ds]]
  idx <- m |> group_by(gear_class, dist_band, moy) |> summarise(mm = mean(density), .groups = "drop") |>
    group_by(gear_class, dist_band) |> mutate(season_index = mm / mean(mm)) |> ungroup()
  m |>
    filter(between(months_since_first_found, -qparams$event_window, qparams$event_window)) |>
    left_join(select(idx, gear_class, dist_band, moy, season_index), by = c("gear_class", "dist_band", "moy")) |>
    mutate(adj = if_else(season_index > 0, density / season_index, 0)) |>
    group_by(gear_class, nearest_project, dist_band) |>
    group_modify(function(g, k) {
      cells <- unique(g$cell_id)
      by_cell <- split(g, g$cell_id)
      set.seed(42)
      reps <- map_dfr(seq_len(199), function(b) {
        bind_rows(by_cell[sample(cells, replace = TRUE)]) |>
          group_by(months_since_first_found) |> summarise(v = mean(adj), .groups = "drop")
      })
      g |> group_by(months_since_first_found) |> summarise(rate = mean(adj), .groups = "drop") |>
        left_join(reps |> group_by(months_since_first_found) |>
                    summarise(lo = quantile(v, 0.025), hi = quantile(v, 0.975), .groups = "drop"),
                  by = "months_since_first_found")
    }) |> ungroup()
}, .id = "dataset") |>
  mutate(dist_band = factor(dist_band, band_order))
save_tab(event, "bag_event_time")

for (ds in datasets) {
  p <- event |> filter(dataset == ds, dist_band %in% c("inside", "0-2", "8-15")) |>
    ggplot(aes(months_since_first_found, rate, colour = dist_band, fill = dist_band)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(inside = "#d03b3b", `0-2` = "#eb6834", `8-15` = "#52514e"),
                        aesthetics = c("colour", "fill")) +
    facet_grid(gear_class ~ nearest_project, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "months since the nearest project's first foundation",
         y = "season-adjusted density (h km⁻² month⁻¹)", colour = "band (km)", fill = "band (km)",
         title = paste(ds_label[[ds]], "event time around each project's first foundation"))
  save_fig(p, sprintf("bag_event_time_%s", ds), height = 9)
  print(p)
}
```

## Vessel records

Primary records per vessel, read once. They serve the term-support check
below (how many vessels back each term, D-076) and the leave-one-vessel-out
refits (step 8). `vessel_month` holds each vessel's hours per cell and
month; the support check matches it to the model rows by cell and stage ×
season, or by cell and time-step end for the timing models.

```{r}
records_path <- \(ds) file.path(paths$processed_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_id_classified.csv", ds))
vessel_month <- map_dfr(set_names(datasets), \(ds)
  read_csv(records_path(ds), col_types = cols(.default = "c"),
           col_select = c(MMSI, `Vessel Name`, cell_id, gear_class, in_primary, hours, date)) |>
    filter(in_primary == "TRUE") |>
    mutate(hours = as.numeric(hours), m = floor_date(as.Date(date), "month")) |>
    group_by(MMSI, vessel = `Vessel Name`, cell_id, gear_class, m) |>
    summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop"), .id = "dataset")
input_files <- c(input_files, records_path(datasets))

# per cell × stage × season (stage × season models and leave-one-vessel-out)
vessel_hours <- vessel_month |>
  mutate(stage = stage_of(m), season = season_of(m)) |>
  group_by(dataset, MMSI, vessel, cell_id, gear_class, stage, season) |>
  summarise(hours = sum(hours), .groups = "drop")
vessel_ss <- vessel_hours |> filter(hours > 0) |> distinct(dataset, gear_class, cell_id, stage, season, MMSI)
# per cell × time step, keyed by the step's last day (timing models)
vessel_step <- map(c(month = "month", season_year = "season_year"), \(step)
  vessel_month |> filter(hours > 0) |> mutate(step_end = step_end_of(m, step)) |>
    distinct(dataset, gear_class, cell_id, step_end, MMSI))
```

## Model specifications

Every model is written once as a **specification**: its data, formula and
settings (the cache key for `fit_cached()`) and a self-contained fit
function. The next section fits every specification not yet cached, in
parallel; later sections read the fits from the cache. Each fit function
uses only its own data and namespaced `sdmTMB` calls, so it runs unchanged
in a separate R process.

**Convergence.** A fit is accepted when the Hessian is positive definite,
the optimiser converged and the gradients are small (`sanity()`).
`se_magnitude_ok` is not required: when the depth effect is close to linear,
the depth smooth's wiggliness parameter goes to zero and its standard error
is uninformative. That is harmless, and it is the common case for the sparse
gears.

```{r}
cutoff <- qparams$mesh_cutoff_km

# a fit specification: the cache key and a fit function that runs anywhere
make_spec <- function(id, d, formula, family, spatiotemporal = "off", time = NULL, knots = NULL) {
  force(d); force(formula); force(family); force(spatiotemporal); force(time); force(knots)
  cut <- cutoff
  key <- list(data = d, formula = formula, family = family, cutoff = cut, spatial = "on",
              spatiotemporal = spatiotemporal, time = time, knots = knots)
  fun <- function() {
    fam <- switch(family, nbinom2 = sdmTMB::nbinom2(), tweedie = sdmTMB::tweedie(),
                  delta_gamma = sdmTMB::delta_gamma())
    mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(d, c("x_km", "y_km"), cutoff = cut)
    sdmTMB::sdmTMB(formula, data = d, mesh = mesh, family = fam, offset = d$log_expo,
                   spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = spatiotemporal, time = time, knots = knots,
                   silent = TRUE)
  }
  list(id = id, key = key, fun = fun)
}
get_fit <- \(spec) fit_cached(spec$key, spec$fun, dir = paths$models, label = spec$id)
fit_ok <- \(f) { s <- sanity(f, silent = TRUE); isTRUE(s$hessian_ok && s$eigen_values_ok && s$nlminb_ok && s$gradients_ok) }

# --- stage × season (steps 3, 5) --------------------------------------------
ss_cols <- c("cell_id", "stage", "stage_num", "season", "dist_band", "hours", "log_expo",
             "depth_m", "slope_z", "bpi_z", "x_km", "y_km")
# `bands`: the distance-band scheme (D-076), "full" (inside, 0–2, 2–4, 4–8
# km) or "merged" (near = inside + 0–2, mid = 2–8 km); 8–15 km is the
# reference in both
ss_data <- function(ds, g, bands = "full") {
  d <- ss[[ds]] |> filter(gear_class == g, domain) |> bag_prepare() |>
    mutate(stage_num = as.integer(stage)) |> select(all_of(ss_cols))
  if (bands == "merged") d <- mutate(d, dist_band = merge_bands(dist_band))
  d
}
ss_formula <- hours ~ stage * dist_band + season + s(depth_m, k = 4) + slope_z + bpi_z
ss_base_formula <- hours ~ stage + dist_band + season + s(depth_m, k = 4) + slope_z + bpi_z
# the BAG terms and the headline term of a band scheme: the Stage 2 and
# Stage 3 × near-band interactions (inside and 0–2 km, or near when merged)
near_bands <- \(bands) if (bands == "full") c("inside", "0-2") else "near"
bag_terms_of <- \(bands) paste0("stageStage ", rep(2:3, length(near_bands(bands))), ":dist_band",
                                rep(near_bands(bands), each = 2))
headline_of <- \(bands) paste0("stageStage 3:dist_band", near_bands(bands)[1])
all_bag_terms <- unique(c(bag_terms_of("full"), bag_terms_of("merged")))
# every stage × band term of a scheme, for the full grid and the gradient
# test (D-091): Stages 2 and 3 × all four bands (full), or × near and mid
# (merged). Kept apart from bag_terms_of(), which the power, leave-one-
# vessel-out and robustness refits use, so their results and caches do not
# change
grid_terms_of <- \(bands, stages = 2:3) {
  b <- unname(band_schemes[[bands]])
  paste0("stageStage ", rep(stages, each = length(b)), ":dist_band", rep(b, length(stages)))
}
# the headline row of each model in a results table with id and term
headline_rows <- \(tab) semi_join(tab, transmute(ss_sets, id, term = headline), by = c("id", "term"))
# a spatial field shared by all stages plus an iid field per stage (plan, Phase 5 sketch)
ss_spec <- \(id, d, formula, family) make_spec(id, d, formula, family, "iid", "stage_num")

# cells with any area in an active safety zone in any month (caveat 17)
zone_cells <- month$vp |> filter(sz_share > 0) |> distinct(cell_id) |> pull()
```

### Term support (D-076)

Before any fit, every 0/1 fixed-effect column of every model is counted:
the rows it switches on, the **positive** rows among them (hours > 0), and
the distinct cells and vessels with effort in those rows
(`term_support()`). A term is supported if it has at least
`r qparams$support_min_positive` positive rows from at least
`r qparams$support_min_cells` cells and `r qparams$support_min_vessels`
vessels. The thresholds are parameters, set before fitting. The rule is
applied the same way to every model, with no case-by-case choices:

- **BAG terms** (stage × band; construction and development × band):
  if any lacks support, the model pools its bands (near = inside + 0–2 km,
  mid = 2–8 km). If the pooled terms still lack support, the model is not
  fitted and that gear is reported descriptively.
- **Lead terms** (leads model): if any lacks support, the three lead bins
  pool into one (24–1 months). If that still fails, no leads model is
  fitted.
- **Foundation distance** (*h*(·)): bands coarsen from 0–2 / 2–5 / 5–10 km
  to 0–5 / 5–10, then 0–10, and the term is dropped if even that fails.
- **Other indicators** (post-construction × band, active construction):
  dropped one by one if unsupported.

The decisions are logged in `bag_support_rules`, and every count in
`bag_term_support`. No new term enters a main model after this point.
New questions go into separate sensitivity fits, as the leads model does
(D-076).

```{r}
sup_ok <- \(sup) support_ok(sup, qparams$support_min_positive, qparams$support_min_cells,
                            qparams$support_min_vessels)
# the support of a stage × season model's terms; vessels matched by cell,
# stage and season
ss_support <- function(ds, g, d)
  term_support(ss_formula, d, filter(vessel_ss, dataset == ds, gear_class == g), c("cell_id", "stage", "season"))
# the finest band scheme whose BAG terms are all supported, or "none"
choose_ss <- function(ds, g) {
  sup_all <- NULL
  for (b in names(band_schemes)) {
    sup <- ss_support(ds, g, ss_data(ds, g, b)) |> mutate(bands = b)
    sup_all <- bind_rows(sup_all, sup)
    if (all(sup_ok(filter(sup, term %in% bag_terms_of(b))))) return(list(bands = b, support = sup_all))
  }
  list(bands = "none", support = sup_all)
}

ss_choice <- ss_models |> mutate(choice = map2(dataset, gear, choose_ss), bands = map_chr(choice, "bands"))
# a gear whose pooled BAG terms still lack support is reported descriptively
# only (step 1) and has no stage × season model
ss_sets <- ss_choice |> filter(bands != "none") |>
  mutate(data = pmap(list(dataset, gear, bands), ss_data),
         terms = map(bands, bag_terms_of), headline = map_chr(bands, headline_of),
         spec = pmap(list(id, data, family), \(id, d, fam) ss_spec(id, d, ss_formula, fam)),
         spec_base = pmap(list(id, data, family), \(id, d, fam) ss_spec(paste(id, "base"), d, ss_base_formula, fam)),
         spec_nozone = pmap(list(id, data, family), \(id, d, fam)
           ss_spec(paste(id, "no zone cells"), filter(d, !cell_id %in% zone_cells), ss_formula, fam)),
         # AFE: the delta-Gamma hurdle alongside Tweedie (plan, "Response families")
         spec_dg = pmap(list(id, data, dataset), \(id, d, ds)
           if (ds == "afe") ss_spec(paste(id, "delta_gamma"), d, ss_formula, "delta_gamma") else NULL))
ss_sets |> transmute(id, bands, cells = map_int(data, \(d) n_distinct(d$cell_id)), rows = map_int(data, nrow),
                     positive_rows = map_int(data, \(d) sum(d$hours > 0))) |> knitr::kable()

# --- timing and pre-trend (steps 4, 6) ----------------------------------------
timing_models <- tribble(~dataset, ~gear, ~step,
                         "vp", "MOBILE", "month", "vp", "FIXED", "month", "vp", "POLE_AND_LINE", "month",
                         "afe", "MOBILE", "month", "afe", "FIXED", "season_year") |>
  mutate(id = paste(dataset, gear, sep = "_"),
         family = if_else(dataset == "vp", "nbinom2", "tweedie"))

# `bands`: the distance-band scheme (D-076); `cuts`: the foundation-distance
# band edges for h(·), coarsened when the finer bands lack support
timing_data <- function(ds, g, step, bands = "full", cuts = c(2, 5, 10)) {
  base <- if (step == "month") month[[ds]] else sy_afe
  d <- base |> filter(gear_class == g, domain) |> bag_prepare()
  if (bands == "merged") d <- mutate(d, dist_band = merge_bands(dist_band))
  bx <- band_schemes[[bands]]
  d |>
    mutate(year_c = if (step == "month") (t_index - 1) / 12 - 5 else season_year - 2021,
           season = factor(season, c("AprSep", "OctMar")),
           construction = as.numeric(phase == "construction"),
           post = as.numeric(phase == "post_construction"),
           found_band = found_band_of(d_found_km, cuts),
           active = if (step == "month") as.numeric(active_construction) else active_construction_share,
           year_num = if (step == "month") as.numeric(year) else as.numeric(season_year),
           time_year = as.integer(year_num),
           # Stage 2 as its own phase (D-075): pre-construction steps from
           # Stage 2 on (site surveys, boulder clearance) are "development",
           # so "pre" in the construction terms means Stage 1 only, and the
           # dx_* terms estimate any anticipation instead of assuming none.
           # For RWF- and SRW-nearest cells development runs into Stage 3,
           # up to their own project's first works.
           development = as.numeric(phase == "pre" & stage != "Stage 1"),
           # last day of the time step, for the 2016–2019 pre-trend fit and
           # the vessel match; season-year OctMar Y runs October Y − 1 to
           # March Y (season_year_of(), r/analysis_helpers.R)
           step_end = if (step == "month") ceiling_date(as.Date(year_month), "month") - 1
                      else season_year_end(season, season_year),
           # event-time leads (D-075): months to the cell's first
           # construction step, binned inside development
           step_idx = if (step == "month") t_index else season_year_index(season, season_year),
           lead_months = months_to_works(cell_id, step_idx, phase, if (step == "month") 1 else 6),
           pre_bin = pre_period_bin(phase, development == 1, lead_months),
           dev_early = as.numeric(pre_bin %in% "dev_early"),
           lead_24_13 = as.numeric(pre_bin %in% "lead_24_13"),
           lead_12_1 = as.numeric(pre_bin %in% "lead_12_1"),
           # the pooled lead bin, when the three bins lack support (D-076)
           lead_24_1 = lead_24_13 + lead_12_1) |>
    band_interactions("construction", "cx", bx) |>
    band_interactions("post", "post", bx) |>
    band_interactions("development", "dx", bx) |>
    band_interactions("dev_early", "de", bx) |>
    band_interactions("lead_24_13", "l24", bx) |>
    band_interactions("lead_12_1", "l12", bx) |>
    band_interactions("lead_24_1", "l241", bx)
}
# the indicator × band columns of a scheme, e.g. band_cols("cx", "full") gives
# cx_inside, cx_0_2, cx_2_4, cx_4_8
band_cols <- \(prefix, bands = "full") paste0(prefix, "_", names(band_schemes[[bands]]))
timing_core <- c("cell_id", "hours", "log_expo", "dist_band", "phase", "stage", "step_end", "year_c", "construction",
                 "found_band", "development", "pre_bin", "dev_early", "lead_24_13", "lead_12_1", "lead_24_1",
                 "active", "sz_share", "depth_m", "slope_z", "bpi_z", "year_num", "time_year", "x_km", "y_km")
timing_select <- \(d) select(d, all_of(timing_core), matches("^(cx|post|dx|de|l24|l12|l241)_"),
                             any_of(c("moy", "season")))
pretrend_formula <- function(step) {
  if (step == "month") hours ~ dist_band * year_c + s(moy, bs = "cc", k = 8) + s(depth_m, k = 4) + slope_z + bpi_z
  else hours ~ dist_band * year_c + season + s(depth_m, k = 4) + slope_z + bpi_z
}
# How the pre-construction period is split (D-075): the main timing model
# gives development one set of band terms; the leads model splits it by
# months to the works, in three bins or, when those lack support, one.
dev_terms_of   <- \(b) c("development", band_cols("dx", b))
lead3_terms_of <- \(b) c("dev_early", "lead_24_13", "lead_12_1", band_cols("de", b), band_cols("l24", b), band_cols("l12", b))
lead1_terms_of <- \(b) c("dev_early", "lead_24_1", band_cols("de", b), band_cols("l241", b))
# `terms`: the fixed effects other than the terrain covariates and smooths,
# in the order construction, construction × band, post × band, the pre-period
# split, found_band, active, sz_share, dist_band
timing_formula <- function(step, terms) {
  common <- paste(c(terms, "s(depth_m, k = 4)", "slope_z", "bpi_z"), collapse = " + ")
  as.formula(if (step == "month") paste("hours ~", common, "+ s(moy, bs = 'cc', k = 8) + s(year_num, k = 5)")
             else paste("hours ~", common, "+ season + s(year_num, k = 5)"))
}
month_knots <- \(step) if (step == "month") list(moy = c(0.5, 12.5)) else NULL
timing_terms_of <- \(b, pre, post_keep, found = TRUE, active = TRUE)
  c("construction", band_cols("cx", b), post_keep, pre, if (found) "found_band", if (active) "active", "sz_share", "dist_band")

# The support rule for one timing model (D-076), in a fixed order: band
# scheme from the construction and development × band terms; then the
# foundation-distance bands; then the optional post-construction and active
# terms; then the lead bins. Returns the scheme, the data, the main and leads
# fixed terms (NULL when unsupported), the support counts and a log.
plan_timing <- function(ds, g, step) {
  vess <- filter(vessel_step[[step]], dataset == ds, gear_class == g)
  supp <- \(d, terms) term_support(timing_formula(step, terms), d, vess, c("cell_id", "step_end"))
  ok_of <- \(sup) set_names(sup_ok(sup), sup$term)
  log <- character()
  tried <- NULL   # support of each band scheme tried, kept when none passes
  # 1. band scheme
  for (b in names(band_schemes)) {
    d <- timing_data(ds, g, step, b)
    terms <- timing_terms_of(b, dev_terms_of(b), band_cols("post", b))
    sup_b <- supp(d, terms)
    tried <- bind_rows(tried, mutate(sup_b, model = "timing", bands = b))
    ok <- ok_of(sup_b)
    if (all(ok[c(band_cols("cx", b), band_cols("dx", b))] %in% TRUE)) break
    log <- c(log, paste(b, "bands: a construction or development × band term lacks support"))
    if (b == "merged") return(list(bands = "none", log = log, support = tried))
  }
  # 2. foundation-distance bands, finest supported cut
  found <- FALSE
  for (cuts in list(c(2, 5, 10), c(5, 10), 10)) {
    d <- timing_data(ds, g, step, b, cuts)
    ok <- ok_of(supp(d, terms))
    lv <- paste0("found_band", levels(d$found_band)[-1])
    if (all(ok[lv] %in% TRUE)) { found <- TRUE; break }
    log <- c(log, paste0("found_band cuts ", paste(cuts, collapse = "/"), " km: a band lacks support"))
  }
  if (!found) { cuts <- c(2, 5, 10); d <- timing_data(ds, g, step, b, cuts); log <- c(log, "found_band dropped") }
  # 3. optional terms: post × band and (monthly) active construction
  post_keep <- band_cols("post", b)[ok[band_cols("post", b)] %in% TRUE]
  if (length(setdiff(band_cols("post", b), post_keep)))
    log <- c(log, paste("dropped:", paste(setdiff(band_cols("post", b), post_keep), collapse = ", ")))
  active <- !("active" %in% names(ok)) || isTRUE(ok[["active"]])
  if (!active) log <- c(log, "dropped: active")
  terms <- timing_terms_of(b, dev_terms_of(b), post_keep, found, active)
  sup <- supp(d, terms) |> mutate(model = "timing")
  # 4. lead bins: three, else one, else none
  lead_terms <- NULL
  for (lt in list(lead3_terms_of(b), lead1_terms_of(b))) {
    terms_l <- timing_terms_of(b, lt, post_keep, found, active)
    sup_l <- supp(d, terms_l) |> mutate(model = "leads")
    if (all(ok_of(sup_l)[setdiff(lt, "dev_early")] %in% TRUE)) { lead_terms <- terms_l; break }
    log <- c(log, paste0("leads (", if (identical(lt, lead3_terms_of(b))) "three bins" else "one bin",
                         "): a lead term lacks support"))
  }
  if (is.null(lead_terms)) log <- c(log, "no leads model")
  list(bands = b, cuts = cuts, data = timing_select(d), terms = terms, lead_terms = lead_terms,
       support = bind_rows(mutate(sup, bands = b), if (!is.null(lead_terms)) mutate(sup_l, bands = b)), log = log)
}

# A spec, or NULL when the support rule left no model to fit
spec_or_null <- \(ok, ...) if (ok) make_spec(...) else NULL
timing_sets <- timing_models |>
  left_join(select(ss_choice, id, pre_bands = bands), by = "id") |>
  mutate(plan = pmap(list(dataset, gear, step), plan_timing),
         bands = map_chr(plan, "bands"),
         # pre-trend data use the stage × season model's band scheme, so the
         # gate tests the bands that model estimates
         pre_data = pmap(list(dataset, gear, step, pre_bands), \(ds, g, step, b)
           if (b == "none") NULL else timing_select(timing_data(ds, g, step, b))),
         # pre-trend: pre-construction months, persistent field only
         spec_pre = pmap(list(id, pre_data, step, family), \(id, d, step, fam)
           spec_or_null(!is.null(d), paste(id, "pretrend"), filter(d, phase == "pre"), pretrend_formula(step), fam,
                        knots = month_knots(step))),
         # diagnostic pre-trend fits (D-075): Stage 1 only, without the
         # Stage 2 site work; and 2016–2019, without COVID as well
         spec_pre_s1 = pmap(list(id, pre_data, step, family), \(id, d, step, fam)
           spec_or_null(!is.null(d), paste(id, "pretrend stage 1"), filter(d, phase == "pre", stage == "Stage 1"),
                        pretrend_formula(step), fam, knots = month_knots(step))),
         spec_pre_1619 = pmap(list(id, pre_data, step, family), \(id, d, step, fam)
           spec_or_null(!is.null(d), paste(id, "pretrend 2016-2019"),
                        filter(d, phase == "pre", step_end <= as.Date("2019-12-31")),
                        pretrend_formula(step), fam, knots = month_knots(step))),
         # timing BAG: persistent field plus an AR1 field over years
         spec_timing = pmap(list(id, plan, step, family), \(id, pl, step, fam)
           spec_or_null(pl$bands != "none", paste(id, "timing"), pl$data, timing_formula(step, pl$terms), fam,
                        "ar1", "time_year", knots = month_knots(step))),
         # the same with development split into event-time leads (D-075)
         spec_timing_leads = pmap(list(id, plan, step, family), \(id, pl, step, fam)
           spec_or_null(!is.null(pl$lead_terms), paste(id, "timing leads"), pl$data,
                        timing_formula(step, pl$lead_terms), fam, "ar1", "time_year", knots = month_knots(step))))
timing_sets |> filter(!map_lgl(pre_data, is.null)) |>
  transmute(id, step, pre_bands, timing_bands = bands, rows = map_int(pre_data, nrow),
            cells = map_int(pre_data, \(d) n_distinct(d$cell_id)),
            pre_rows = map_int(pre_data, \(d) sum(d$phase == "pre")),
            stage1_rows = map_int(pre_data, \(d) sum(d$pre_bin %in% "baseline")),
            pre_2016_2019_rows = map_int(pre_data, \(d) sum(d$phase == "pre" & d$step_end <= as.Date("2019-12-31"))),
            dev_early_rows = map_int(pre_data, \(d) sum(d$pre_bin %in% "dev_early")),
            lead_24_13_rows = map_int(pre_data, \(d) sum(d$pre_bin %in% "lead_24_13")),
            lead_12_1_rows = map_int(pre_data, \(d) sum(d$pre_bin %in% "lead_12_1"))) |> knitr::kable()

# the support rule's decisions and every count behind them (D-076)
support_rules <- bind_rows(
  ss_choice |> transmute(id, model = "stage × season", decision = paste("bands:", bands)),
  timing_sets |> transmute(id, model = "timing",
                           decision = map_chr(plan, \(pl) paste(c(paste("bands:", pl$bands),
                             if (!is.null(pl$cuts) && pl$bands != "none") paste0("found_band cuts: ", paste(pl$cuts, collapse = "/")),
                             pl$log), collapse = "; "))))
save_tab(support_rules, "bag_support_rules")
support_rules |> knitr::kable()
term_support_tab <- bind_rows(
  ss_choice |> transmute(id, s = map(choice, "support")) |> unnest(s) |> mutate(model = "stage × season"),
  timing_sets |> transmute(id, s = map(plan, "support")) |> unnest(s)) |>
  mutate(supported = sup_ok(pick(everything())))
save_tab(term_support_tab, "bag_term_support")

# --- fleet-size sensitivity (step 8; plan caveat 5) ---------------------------
# AOI-wide fleet size per gear and time step: distinct Primary MMSIs of that
# gear transmitting anywhere in the AOI (`n_mmsi_fleet`, built in 05). It is a
# proxy for AIS uptake, which grew over the series.
# The VP count is used for both datasets. The AFE count is the number of
# vessels with apparent fishing that period, which is partly the outcome
# itself: a month with no fishing vessels has zero hours by construction.
# The VP count measures who carried AIS in the AOI, fishing or not.
# Each lookup is keyed by the columns the model data already carry, so it
# joins without adding columns to the base data. That keeps the base models'
# cache keys unchanged:
#   stage × season: stage, season
#   monthly timing: year_num (calendar year) and moy, which identify the month
#   season-year timing (fixed AFE): season and year_num (= season_year)
fleet_vp <- list(
  stage_season = ss$vp |> distinct(gear_class, stage, season, fleet = n_mmsi_fleet),
  month = month$vp |> distinct(gear_class, year_num = as.numeric(year), moy, fleet = n_mmsi_fleet),
  season_year = sy_vp |> distinct(gear_class, season, year_num = as.numeric(season_year), fleet = n_mmsi_fleet))
# one fleet count per gear × time step, or the join would duplicate rows
walk(fleet_vp, \(f) stopifnot("fleet lookup not unique per gear × time step" =
                                !anyDuplicated(select(f, -fleet))))

# Adds `log_fleet` to model data `d` (gear `g`, time step `step`): log(fleet + 1),
# centred on the model data's mean. Uses + 1 because VP pole-and-line has one
# month with no vessels. Centring keeps the intercept at the average fleet.
# Its coefficient is an elasticity: the % change in expected hours per 1%
# change in fleet size. A value near 1 means hours scale with the number of
# vessels carrying AIS.
add_log_fleet <- function(d, g, step) {
  f <- fleet_vp[[step]] |> filter(gear_class == g) |> select(-gear_class)
  keys <- setdiff(names(f), "fleet")
  # the model data hold stage and season as factors, the lookup as characters
  k <- d |> select(all_of(keys)) |> mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
  fl <- left_join(k, f, by = keys)$fleet
  stopifnot("fleet lookup changed the row count" = length(fl) == nrow(d),
            "a model row has no fleet count" = !anyNA(fl))
  lf <- log1p(fl)
  d |> mutate(log_fleet = lf - mean(lf))
}

# the stage × season BAG with the fleet term added; the BAG terms are unchanged
ss_fleet_formula <- update(ss_formula, . ~ . + log_fleet)

ss_sets <- ss_sets |>
  mutate(spec_fleet = pmap(list(id, gear, data, family), \(id, g, d, fam)
    ss_spec(paste(id, "fleet"), add_log_fleet(d, g, "stage_season"), ss_fleet_formula, fam)))
timing_sets <- timing_sets |>
  mutate(spec_timing_fleet = pmap(list(id, gear, plan, step, family), \(id, g, pl, step, fam)
    spec_or_null(pl$bands != "none", paste(id, "timing fleet"), add_log_fleet(pl$data, g, step),
                 timing_formula(step, c(pl$terms, "log_fleet")), fam, "ar1", "time_year",
                 knots = month_knots(step))))

# the fleet values each model sees (raw counts, before the log and centring)
fleet_vp |> imap_dfr(\(f, step) f |> group_by(gear_class) |>
  summarise(steps = n(), min = min(fleet), median = median(fleet), max = max(fleet), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(time_step = step, .before = 1)) |> knitr::kable()

# --- mobile vs fixed (step 7) --------------------------------------------------
gc_formula <- hours ~ gear * stage * dist_band + gear * season + s(depth_m, k = 4) + slope_z + bpi_z
# the joint model uses the coarser of the two gears' band schemes (D-076),
# and is not fitted if either gear has no stage × season model
gc_bands <- map_chr(set_names(datasets), function(ds) {
  b <- ss_choice$bands[ss_choice$id %in% paste(ds, c("MOBILE", "FIXED"), sep = "_")]
  if (any(b == "none")) "none" else if (any(b == "merged")) "merged" else "full"
})
gc_specs <- map(set_names(datasets[gc_bands[datasets] != "none"]), function(ds) {
  d <- bind_rows(ss_data(ds, "MOBILE", gc_bands[[ds]]) |> mutate(gear = "MOBILE"),
                 ss_data(ds, "FIXED", gc_bands[[ds]]) |> mutate(gear = "FIXED")) |>
    mutate(gear = factor(gear, c("MOBILE", "FIXED")),
           # each gear × stage gets its own iid field
           gear_stage = as.integer(interaction(gear, stage, drop = TRUE)))
  make_spec(paste(ds, "gear contrast"), d, gc_formula, if (ds == "vp") "nbinom2" else "tweedie",
            "iid", "gear_stage")
})
```

## Fit every model (parallel)

Every specification above that is not yet cached is fitted here, up to
`r qparams$fit_workers` at a time, each in its own R process. A fit that
fails stops the render with its error. The power and leave-one-vessel-out
refits (steps 3 and 8) run in their own worker pool.

```{r}
# compact(): the support rule (D-076) leaves some timing specs NULL
all_specs <- c(ss_sets$spec, ss_sets$spec_base, ss_sets$spec_nozone, compact(ss_sets$spec_dg),
               compact(timing_sets$spec_pre), compact(timing_sets$spec_timing), gc_specs,
               # Stage 2 diagnostics (D-075)
               compact(timing_sets$spec_pre_s1), compact(timing_sets$spec_pre_1619),
               compact(timing_sets$spec_timing_leads),
               # fleet-size sensitivity (step 8): new fits; the ones above stay cached
               ss_sets$spec_fleet, compact(timing_sets$spec_timing_fleet))
run_specs <- function(specs, workers) {
  todo <- keep(specs, \(s) !file.exists(fit_cache_path(s$key, paths$models)))
  message(length(todo), " of ", length(specs), " fits to run")
  # largest data first, so the long fits start early
  todo <- todo[order(-map_int(todo, \(s) nrow(s$key$data)))]
  running <- list()
  while (length(todo) > 0 || length(running) > 0) {
    while (length(running) < workers && length(todo) > 0) {
      s <- todo[[1]]; todo <- todo[-1]
      running[[s$id]] <- callr::r_bg(function(root, spec, dir) {
        setwd(root)
        suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
        source("r/paths.R"); source("r/gfw_helpers.R"); source("r/analysis_helpers.R")
        fit_cached(spec$key, spec$fun, dir = dir, label = spec$id)
        TRUE
      }, args = list(root = root, spec = s, dir = paths$models), supervise = TRUE)
    }
    Sys.sleep(5)
    for (nm in names(running)) {
      p <- running[[nm]]
      if (!p$is_alive()) {
        if (p$get_exit_status() != 0) stop("fit failed: ", nm, "\n", p$read_all_error())
        running[[nm]] <- NULL
      }
    }
  }
}
t_fit <- system.time(run_specs(all_specs, qparams$fit_workers))[["elapsed"]]
round(t_fit / 60, 1)

fit_log <- map_dfr(all_specs, function(s) {
  f <- as.character(fit_cache_path(s$key, paths$models))
  m <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(f, ".json"))
  tibble(model = s$id, rows = nrow(s$key$data), fit_minutes = round(m$fit_seconds / 60, 1),
         converged = fit_ok(readRDS(f)))
})
save_tab(fit_log, "bag_fit_log")
fit_log |> knitr::kable()
```

## Step 3: simulation power

For each dataset × gear: fit the **base model** (the stage × season model
without the BAG terms), simulate `r qparams$power_nsim` new datasets from it
with **new spatial random fields** each time (`simulate(re_form = ~0)`), so
spatial uncertainty is included (conservative). Inject a known BAG effect
in Stage 3, in the shape the pre-registration fixes for each gear (plan,
@sec-bag-power; D-091), by binomial thinning for VP counts and scaling for
AFE (`power_effect_factor()`, `r/bag_helpers.R`). Effects are planted by
each cell's own band, whatever band scheme the refit uses:

- **Matching scenario**, which defines the MDE, at *e* ∈
  {`r paste(100 * unlist(qparams$power_effects), collapse = ", ")`}%: the
  mean times (1 − *e*) in the `inside` band alone for a gear fitted with
  the four bands, so the MDE is that of its Stage 3 × inside headline; in
  `inside` and `0–2` km for a gear whose bands are pooled (D-076), the
  cells of its Stage 3 × near headline.
- **Fading gradient**, for the gradient test's power only, at
  *e* = `r 100 * qparams$power_fade_effect`%: (1 − *e*) inside,
  (1 − *e*/2) at 0–2 km and (1 − *e*/4) at 2–4 km, a displacement that
  weakens with distance. Its *e* = 0 run is the matching scenario's, since
  nothing is planted.

The full BAG model is refitted to each. Two things are scored: the
headline rate ratio (power: 95% CI excludes 1; bias; coverage), and the
gradient test, the Wald test of all Stage 3 × band terms at α = 0.05
(power, and at *e* = 0 its false-positive rate). The same simulated datasets
are reused across effect sizes and scenarios, so the curves differ only by
the effect.

The refits run as `r qparams$workers` separate R processes (`callr`), each
writing one small result file per refit to `reports/bag/{pipeline}/cache/`, so an
interrupted render resumes where it stopped.

```{r}
# a job: one response vector to refit with the full stage × season model.
# Shared by the power analysis and the leave-one-vessel-out refits (step 8)
# `term`, `terms`: the model's headline and BAG terms, which depend on its
# band scheme (D-076). `wald_terms`: if given, the terms of the gradient test
# (D-091), whose Wald statistic each worker also computes from the refit's
# fixed-effect covariance and stores as wald_chi2, wald_df and wald_p. The
# power analysis passes them; leave-one-vessel-out does not need them
run_refit_jobs <- function(spec_id, d, family, jobs, term, terms, wald_terms = NULL,
                           workers = qparams$workers) {
  # spec on disk, read by every worker; its hash names the result folder, so
  # a changed specification never reuses old results. wald_terms joins the
  # spec only when given, so a caller without it keeps its existing key
  spec <- list(data = d, formula = ss_formula, family = family, cutoff = qparams$mesh_cutoff_km,
               term = term, terms = terms)
  if (!is.null(wald_terms)) spec$wald_terms <- wald_terms
  key <- substr(digest::digest(list(spec, as.character(packageVersion("sdmTMB"))), algo = "sha256"), 1, 10)
  out_dir <- file.path(job_dir, paste(spec_id, key, sep = "_"))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  spec_file <- file.path(out_dir, "spec.rds")
  if (!file.exists(spec_file)) saveRDS(spec, spec_file)
  # each result file is named by its tag and a hash of its response vector,
  # so a refit is reused only for exactly the same simulated data
  jobs <- jobs |> mutate(tag0 = tag, tag = paste0(tag, "_", map_chr(y, \(v) substr(digest::digest(v), 1, 8))))
  todo <- jobs |> mutate(file = file.path(out_dir, paste0(tag, ".rds"))) |> filter(!file.exists(file))
  if (nrow(todo) > 0) {
    chunks <- split(todo, rep_len(seq_len(min(workers, nrow(todo))), nrow(todo)))
    procs <- map(chunks, function(ch) {
      jf <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds"); saveRDS(ch, jf)
      callr::r_bg(function(root, spec_file, jobs_file) {
        setwd(root)
        suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(sdmTMB); library(dplyr) })
        # fit_wald() and wald_joint(), for the gradient test (D-091); the
        # helpers file only defines functions and constants, so sourcing it
        # has no side effects in the worker
        source("r/bag_helpers.R")
        spec <- readRDS(spec_file); jobs <- readRDS(jobs_file)
        wt <- spec$wald_terms
        # the gradient test of one refit, by fit_wald() (labels from the
        # design matrix, as in Step 5); NA when the refit failed or its terms
        # cannot be matched to the covariance
        wald_of <- function(fit) {
          if (is.null(fit)) return(data.frame(wald_chi2 = NA_real_, wald_df = length(wt), wald_p = NA_real_))
          w <- fit_wald(fit, wt)
          data.frame(wald_chi2 = w$chi2, wald_df = w$df, wald_p = w$p)
        }
        fam <- switch(spec$family, nbinom2 = nbinom2(), tweedie = tweedie())
        mesh <- make_mesh(spec$data, c("x_km", "y_km"), cutoff = spec$cutoff)
        for (j in seq_len(nrow(jobs))) {
          d <- spec$data; d$hours <- jobs$y[[j]]
          fit <- try(sdmTMB(spec$formula, data = d, mesh = mesh, family = fam, offset = d$log_expo,
                            spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = "iid", time = "stage_num", silent = TRUE),
                     silent = TRUE)
          # the same convergence rule as fit_ok() in the main session
          ok <- !inherits(fit, "try-error") &&
            isTRUE(all(unlist(sanity(fit, silent = TRUE))[c("hessian_ok", "eigen_values_ok", "nlminb_ok", "gradients_ok")]))
          res <- if (ok) {
            t <- tidy(fit)
            r <- t[t$term %in% spec$terms, c("term", "estimate", "std.error")]
            # one gradient test per refit, repeated on each of its term rows
            if (!is.null(wt)) r <- cbind(r, wald_of(fit))
            r
          } else {
            r <- data.frame(term = spec$term, estimate = NA_real_, std.error = NA_real_)
            if (!is.null(wt)) r <- cbind(r, wald_of(NULL))
            r
          }
          saveRDS(cbind(res, tag = jobs$tag[j]), file.path(dirname(spec_file), paste0(jobs$tag[j], ".rds")))
        }
        TRUE
      }, args = list(root = root, spec_file = spec_file, jobs_file = jf), supervise = TRUE)
    })
    walk(procs, \(p) p$wait())
    fails <- keep(procs, \(p) p$get_exit_status() != 0)
    if (length(fails) > 0) stop(length(fails), " refit workers failed: ", fails[[1]]$read_all_error())
  }
  # results carry the caller's original tag
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(jobs)), \(j) readRDS(file.path(out_dir, paste0(jobs$tag[j], ".rds"))) |>
            mutate(tag = jobs$tag0[j]))
}
```

```{r}
# the scenario that defines a gear's MDE (D-091): the planted effect covers
# exactly the cells of its headline term
matching_scenario <- \(bands) if (bands == "full") "inside" else "near"

power_runs <- ss_sets |>
  mutate(res = pmap(list(id, dataset, gear, bands, data, family, spec_base, headline, terms),
                    function(id, ds, g, b, d, fam, sb, hl, tm) {
    base <- get_fit(sb)
    sims <- simulate(base, nsim = qparams$power_nsim, re_form = ~0, seed = 42)
    # each row's own full band: a pooled model's data hold near / mid, but
    # the effect is planted by the four bands. ss_data() only recodes the
    # band column when it pools, so its full-band table has the same rows in
    # the same order; checked, since a misaligned vector would plant the
    # effect in the wrong cells
    full <- ss_data(ds, g, "full")
    stopifnot("full-band rows do not line up with the model data" =
                identical(full$cell_id, d$cell_id) && identical(full$stage, d$stage) &&
                identical(full$season, d$season))
    band_full <- full$dist_band
    type <- if (fam == "nbinom2") "count" else "continuous"
    # the matching scenario at every effect size, then the fading gradient
    # at its one effect size; matching tags keep the format of the earlier
    # single-scenario runs
    jobs <- bind_rows(
      expand_grid(effect = unlist(qparams$power_effects), sim = seq_len(qparams$power_nsim)) |>
        mutate(scenario = matching_scenario(b), tag = sprintf("power_e%02d_s%03d", round(100 * effect), sim)),
      expand_grid(effect = qparams$power_fade_effect, sim = seq_len(qparams$power_nsim)) |>
        mutate(scenario = "fading", tag = sprintf("power_fade_e%02d_s%03d", round(100 * effect), sim))) |>
      mutate(y = pmap(list(scenario, effect, sim), \(sc, e, i)
        inject_effect(sims[, i], power_effect_factor(d$stage, band_full, sc, e), type, seed = i)))
    run_refit_jobs(id, d, fam, jobs, hl, tm, wald_terms = grid_terms_of(b, stages = 3)) |>
      filter(term == hl) |>
      left_join(select(jobs, tag, scenario, effect, sim), by = "tag")
  })) |>
  select(id, dataset, gear, bands, res) |> unnest(res)
save_tab(power_runs, "bag_power_runs")

# the headline term's power, bias and coverage, per scenario and effect
power <- power_runs |>
  group_by(id, dataset, gear, bands, scenario, effect) |>
  summarise(power_from_refits(estimate, std.error, first(effect)) |> select(-effect), .groups = "drop")
save_tab(power, "bag_power")
# the MDE from the matching scenario only (D-091); the fading gradient has a
# single effect size and is not the headline's shape
mde <- power |> filter(scenario != "fading") |>
  group_by(id, dataset, gear, bands, scenario) |>
  summarise(mde = mde_of(effect, power), fpr = power[effect == 0], .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(mde_scenario = scenario) |>
  mutate(descriptive_only = is.na(mde) | mde > 0.5)
save_tab(mde, "bag_mde")
power |> kable_round(3)
mde |> kable_round(2)

# the gradient test's power (D-091): per scenario and effect, the share of
# converged refits whose Wald test rejects; at e = 0, its false-positive rate
gradient_power <- power_runs |>
  group_by(id, dataset, gear, bands, scenario, effect) |>
  summarise(wald_power(wald_p), .groups = "drop")
save_tab(gradient_power, "bag_gradient_power")
gradient_power |> kable_round(3)

p <- ggplot(filter(power, scenario != "fading"), aes(100 * effect, power, colour = gear)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.8), linetype = c(3, 2), colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gear_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, labeller = labeller(dataset = ds_label)) +
  labs(x = "injected effect: % reduction in the headline's cells in Stage 3", y = "power",
       colour = NULL, title = "BAG power curves, headline term (interim base model)",
       subtitle = "matching scenario: inside alone (four bands) or inside + 0–2 km (pooled bands)")
save_fig(p, "bag_power_curves", height = 4.5)
p

# the gradient test: its curve in the matching scenario, and the fading
# gradient's single point (triangle) at its effect size
p <- ggplot(gradient_power, aes(100 * effect, power, colour = gear)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.05, 0.8), linetype = c(3, 2), colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(data = filter(gradient_power, scenario != "fading")) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = scenario == "fading"), size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 17), labels = c("matching", "fading gradient"), name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gear_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset, labeller = labeller(dataset = ds_label)) +
  labs(x = "injected effect (%)", y = "rejection rate (α = 0.05)", colour = NULL,
       title = "Gradient test power: Wald test of all Stage 3 × band terms (D-091)",
       subtitle = "at 0%: the false-positive rate; triangles: the fading gradient (e inside, e/2 at 0–2, e/4 at 2–4 km)")
save_fig(p, "bag_gradient_power", height = 4.5)
p
```

## Step 4: pre-trend equivalence test

Each cell's pre-construction months (`phase == "pre"`) at the timing model's
step (monthly; season-year for fixed AFE), with a band-specific linear
trend *θ*<sub>b</sub> relative to the 8–15 km ring. A band is equivalent if
its 90% CI lies inside ±*δ*, with *δ* from the gear's MDE extrapolated over
the gap between the Stage 1 and Stage 3 midpoints (`pretrend_margin()`).
The spatial field here is persistent only (no time-varying field), since
the trend terms are the subject.

**Two diagnostic windows (D-075).** Stage 2 (October 2020 to the first
works) holds site surveys, boulder clearance and, at its start, COVID, so a
departure in the full pre-period may be early disturbance rather than a
long-run trend. The same test therefore runs on **Stage 1 only** (January
2016 – September 2020) and on **2016–2019** (time steps ending by December
2019, without COVID), with the same margin *δ*. The full pre-period verdict
remains the gate; the two diagnostics only say where a departure comes from
(`pretrend_reading()`). They are shorter, so "inconclusive" is more likely.

```{r}
mid <- \(s) dev_stages$start[dev_stages$stage == s] + (dev_stages$end[dev_stages$stage == s] - dev_stages$start[dev_stages$stage == s]) / 2
dt_years <- as.numeric(mid("Stage 3") - mid("Stage 1")) / 365.25
dt_years

# band trends and their TOST outcomes from one pre-trend fit
pretrend_tab <- function(sp, delta) {
  tidy(get_fit(sp)) |> filter(str_detect(term, "^dist_band.*:year_c$")) |>
    mutate(band = str_remove_all(term, "dist_band|:year_c")) |>
    rowwise() |> mutate(tost_band(estimate, std.error, delta)) |> ungroup() |>
    select(band, est, se, lo90, hi90, lo95, hi95, delta, outcome)
}
pretrend_windows <- c(full = "full pre-period", stage1 = "Stage 1 only", pre_covid = "2016–2019")
# every gear with a stage × season model; its pre-trend uses that model's
# band scheme (D-076)
pretrend_all <- timing_sets |> filter(!map_lgl(spec_pre, is.null)) |>
  mutate(res = pmap(list(id, spec_pre, spec_pre_s1, spec_pre_1619), function(id, s0, s1, s2) {
    m <- mde$mde[mde$id == id]
    delta <- pretrend_margin(if (length(m)) m else NA_real_, dt_years)
    bind_rows(full = pretrend_tab(s0, delta), stage1 = pretrend_tab(s1, delta),
              pre_covid = pretrend_tab(s2, delta), .id = "window")
  })) |>
  select(id, dataset, gear, res) |> unnest(res)
save_tab(pretrend_all, "bag_pretrend_windows")

# the gate: the full pre-period, as before
pretrend <- pretrend_all |> filter(window == "full") |> select(-window)
save_tab(pretrend, "bag_pretrend")
pretrend_gate <- pretrend |> group_by(id, dataset, gear) |>
  summarise(verdict = pretrend_verdict(outcome), delta = first(delta), .groups = "drop")
save_tab(pretrend_gate, "bag_pretrend_verdict")
pretrend_gate |> kable_round(4)

# where a departure comes from: the gate's verdict next to the diagnostics
pretrend_where <- pretrend_all |> group_by(id, dataset, gear, window) |>
  summarise(verdict = pretrend_verdict(outcome), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = verdict) |>
  mutate(reading = pretrend_reading(full, stage1, pre_covid))
save_tab(pretrend_where, "bag_pretrend_reading")
pretrend_where |> knitr::kable()

# one row per band and window, offset vertically so the three windows sit
# side by side; the margin is shaded as before
win_cols <- c("full pre-period" = "black", "Stage 1 only" = "#2a78d6", "2016–2019" = "#eb6834")
band_lv <- c("inside", "0-2", "near", "2-4", "4-8", "mid")
pt_plot <- pretrend_all |>
  mutate(window = factor(pretrend_windows[window], pretrend_windows),
         y = match(band, band_lv) + c(0.2, 0, -0.2)[as.integer(window)])
p <- ggplot(pt_plot, aes(est, y, colour = window)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -delta, xmax = delta, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf), fill = "grey92", inherit.aes = FALSE,
            data = distinct(pt_plot, id, dataset, gear, delta)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo95, xmax = hi95), linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo90, xmax = hi90), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(band_lv), labels = band_lv, trans = "reverse") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = win_cols, name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ id, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "band trend relative to the 8–15 km ring (log scale per year)", y = NULL,
       title = "Pre-construction trends by window: 90% (thick) and 95% (thin) CIs; grey = equivalence margin ±δ") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_fig(p, "bag_pretrend", height = 6)
p
```

## Random-field check (D-077)

**Read this before Step 5.** The fixed-effect terms are capped by the
support rule (D-076); the random fields are checked here instead, by how
well each structure **predicts data it has not seen**. Only predictive
scores are shown: no BAG effect is read from these fits, so the choice of
field cannot be steered by the answer it gives.

- **Stage × season models: spatial-block cross-validation.** The study area
  is cut into square blocks at least *ρ*<sub>0</sub> wide (Phase 3's
  practical range for the dataset × gear, `global_rho0.csv`, rounded up),
  and whole blocks are dealt to `r qparams$cv_folds` folds
  (`spatial_block_folds()`). Each fold is held out in turn, the model is
  fitted to the rest, and the held-out rows are scored by their log
  likelihood. Three structures, same fixed effects and family:
  - **shared**: one spatial field for all stages (`spatiotemporal = "off"`);
  - **iid per stage** (the fitted model): the shared field plus an
    independent field per stage;
  - **AR1 per stage**: the shared field plus stage fields correlated from
    one stage to the next.

  Higher summed held-out log likelihood is better. The rule is fixed in
  advance (plan, "Term support and model complexity"): another structure
  replaces the fitted one only if it scores higher in total, scores higher
  in at least four of the five folds (`folds_better`), and has no failed
  fold (`folds_ok` below `folds`: a non-positive-definite Hessian).
- **Timing models: AIC.** Five-fold CV of the monthly timing models would
  take days (each fit is 3–6 h), so the AR1 year field is compared with the
  persistent field alone by AIC on the full data. Both fits are by maximum
  likelihood with the same fixed effects. A variance at its boundary makes
  AIC conservative about dropping the field, which is the safe direction
  here. The AR1 field is dropped only if that lowers AIC by more than 2
  (`d_aic` above 2).

The fitted models are **not** changed by this section in an interim
render. Under the plan, a structure that meets the rule replaces the
fitted one in Phase 5's refit, logged as a new decision; the BAG terms stay
as frozen.

```{r field-check, eval = isTRUE(get0("qparams")$field_check)}
# Phase 3's practical range per dataset × gear (07 writes it); the block
# size for each stage × season model's folds
rho0_path <- file.path(paths$spatial, "tables", "global_rho0.csv")
input_files <- c(input_files, rho0_path)
rho0 <- read_csv(rho0_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(id = paste(dataset, gear_class, sep = "_"), rho0_km, rho0_censored)

# a cross-validation specification: the same cache as make_spec(), but the
# fit function runs sdmTMB_cv and keeps only the scores (no models, no
# coefficients), so nothing here can be read as a BAG effect
make_cv_spec <- function(id, d, formula, family, spatiotemporal, time, folds) {
  force(d); force(formula); force(family); force(spatiotemporal); force(time); force(folds)
  cut <- cutoff
  key <- list(type = "spatial-block cv", data = d, formula = formula, family = family, cutoff = cut,
              spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = spatiotemporal, time = time, folds = folds)
  fun <- function() {
    fam <- switch(family, nbinom2 = sdmTMB::nbinom2(), tweedie = sdmTMB::tweedie())
    # one mesh from all the data, shared by every fold
    mesh <- sdmTMB::make_mesh(d, c("x_km", "y_km"), cutoff = cut)
    # sequential folds: each spec already runs in its own process, and the
    # future packages are not direct dependencies; the offset must be given
    # by column name for sdmTMB_cv
    cv <- sdmTMB::sdmTMB_cv(formula, data = d, mesh = mesh, family = fam, offset = "log_expo",
                            spatial = "on", spatiotemporal = spatiotemporal, time = time,
                            fold_ids = folds, k_folds = max(folds), parallel = FALSE,
                            save_models = FALSE, silent = TRUE)
    list(sum_loglik = cv$sum_loglik, fold_loglik = cv$fold_loglik, pdHess = cv$pdHess,
         max_gradients = cv$max_gradients, fold_rows = as.vector(table(folds)))
  }
  list(id = id, key = key, fun = fun)
}

# the three field structures for the stage × season models
cv_structures <- tribble(~structure, ~spatiotemporal, ~time,
                         "shared", "off", NA,
                         "iid per stage", "iid", "stage_num",
                         "AR1 per stage", "ar1", "stage_num")
cv_sets <- ss_sets |>
  select(id, family, data) |>
  left_join(rho0, by = "id") |>
  # blocks at least ρ0 wide, rounded up to the next km
  mutate(block_km = ceiling(rho0_km),
         folds = map2(data, block_km, \(d, b) spatial_block_folds(d$x_km, d$y_km, b, qparams$cv_folds)),
         blocks = map2_int(data, block_km, \(d, b) n_distinct(floor((d$x_km - min(d$x_km)) / b),
                                                            floor((d$y_km - min(d$y_km)) / b)))) |>
  cross_join(cv_structures) |>
  mutate(spec = pmap(list(id, data, family, spatiotemporal, time, folds, structure),
                     \(id, d, fam, st, tm, fo, s) make_cv_spec(paste(id, "cv", s), d, ss_formula, fam, st,
                                                               if (is.na(tm)) NULL else tm, fo)))

# the timing models without the AR1 year field, for the AIC comparison
field_timing <- timing_sets |> filter(!map_lgl(spec_timing, is.null)) |>
  mutate(spec_nofield = pmap(list(id, plan, step, family), \(id, pl, step, fam)
    make_spec(paste(id, "timing no year field"), pl$data, timing_formula(step, pl$terms), fam,
              knots = month_knots(step))))

field_specs <- c(cv_sets$spec, field_timing$spec_nofield)
t_field <- system.time(run_specs(field_specs, qparams$fit_workers))[["elapsed"]]
round(t_field / 60, 1)
# fit times of the new jobs (the CV jobs are 5 fits each)
field_log <- map_dfr(field_specs, function(s) {
  m <- jsonlite::read_json(paste0(as.character(fit_cache_path(s$key, paths$models)), ".json"))
  tibble(model = s$id, rows = nrow(s$key$data), fit_minutes = round(m$fit_seconds / 60, 1))
})
save_tab(field_log, "bag_field_fit_log")

# cross-validation scores; Δ against the fitted model (iid per stage)
cv_scores <- cv_sets |>
  mutate(cv = map(spec, get_fit)) |>
  transmute(id, structure, block_km, rho0_censored, blocks,
            folds_ok = map_int(cv, \(r) sum(r$pdHess)), folds = map_int(cv, \(r) length(r$pdHess)),
            sum_loglik = map_dbl(cv, "sum_loglik"), fold_loglik = map(cv, "fold_loglik")) |>
  group_by(id) |>
  mutate(ref = fold_loglik[structure == "iid per stage"],
         d_loglik = sum_loglik - sum_loglik[structure == "iid per stage"],
         # folds where this structure scores higher than the fitted one
         folds_better = map2_int(fold_loglik, ref, \(a, b) sum(a > b))) |>
  ungroup() |> select(-ref)
cv_tab <- cv_scores |> mutate(fold_loglik = map_chr(fold_loglik, \(v) paste(round(v, 1), collapse = "; ")))
save_tab(cv_tab, "bag_field_cv")
cv_tab |> select(id, structure, block_km, blocks, folds_ok, folds, sum_loglik, d_loglik, folds_better) |>
  kable_round(1)

# timing models: AIC with and without the AR1 year field
field_aic <- field_timing |>
  transmute(id, ar1 = map(spec_timing, get_fit), off = map(spec_nofield, get_fit)) |>
  transmute(id, converged_ar1 = map_lgl(ar1, fit_ok), converged_off = map_lgl(off, fit_ok),
            aic_ar1 = map_dbl(ar1, AIC), aic_off = map_dbl(off, AIC),
            d_aic = aic_ar1 - aic_off)   # negative: the AR1 year field earns its place
save_tab(field_aic, "bag_field_aic")
field_aic |> kable_round(1)
```

## Step 5: stage × season BAG

The Stage 2 × band terms (`stageStage 2:dist_bandinside`, `…0-2`) compare
Stage 2 with Stage 1 before any foundation or cable went in, so they are
this model's **anticipation estimate** (D-075): a Stage 2 effect means
fishers responded to site surveys, boulder clearance or the prospect of
construction, and Stage 3's terms then measure change from a Stage 1
baseline that Stage 2 had already moved away from.

```{r}
ss_fits <- ss_sets |>
  mutate(fit = map(spec, get_fit),
         fit_dg = map(spec_dg, \(s) if (is.null(s)) NULL else get_fit(s)))
ss_fits |> transmute(id, converged = map_lgl(fit, fit_ok),
                     converged_delta_gamma = map_lgl(fit_dg, \(f) if (is.null(f)) NA else fit_ok(f))) |>
  knitr::kable()

# each model's own BAG terms, from its band scheme (D-076)
bag_rr <- ss_fits |>
  mutate(rr = map2(fit, terms, \(f, tm) rate_ratios(tidy(f), tm))) |>
  select(id, dataset, gear, bands, rr) |> unnest(rr) |>
  mutate(stage = str_extract(term, "Stage [23]"), band = str_extract(term, "inside|0-2|near")) |>
  left_join(select(mde, id, mde, descriptive_only), by = "id")
save_tab(bag_rr, "bag_rate_ratios")
bag_rr |> select(id, bands, stage, band, rr, rr_lo, rr_hi, p, mde, descriptive_only) |> kable_round(3)
```

The delta-Gamma parts for AFE: whether a cell is fished (binomial) and how
much given fished (Gamma). Opposite signs would mean the hurdle is needed on
substance (Phase 5).

```{r}
dg_rr <- ss_fits |> filter(dataset == "afe") |>
  mutate(rr = map2(fit_dg, terms, \(f, tm) bind_rows(
    rate_ratios(tidy(f, model = 1), tm) |> mutate(part = "occupancy (odds ratio)"),
    rate_ratios(tidy(f, model = 2), tm) |> mutate(part = "intensity given fished")))) |>
  select(id, rr) |> unnest(rr)
save_tab(dg_rr, "bag_delta_gamma_parts")
dg_rr |> select(id, part, term, rr, rr_lo, rr_hi, p) |> kable_round(3)
```

### Full stage × band grid and gradient test (D-091)

The headline is one term, Stage 3 × inside (or near), but BAG is about the
gradient, so the pre-registration (plan, @sec-bag-prereg) also fixes two
things that describe its whole shape:

- **The full grid.** Every stage × band term of each headline model:
  Stages 2 and 3 × the four bands (inside, 0–2, 2–4, 4–8 km), or × near and
  mid where the bands are pooled (D-076), each against the 8–15 km ring and
  relative to Stage 1. These are estimates, not verdicts: the robustness
  checks are not applied to them. They show whether a change is confined to
  the leases, spreads into 0–2 km, or fades with distance.
- **The gradient test.** A Wald test that all Stage 3 × band terms are zero
  at once (`wald_joint()`, `r/bag_helpers.R`): χ² with one degree of freedom
  per band, from the fit's fixed-effect covariance, at α = 0.05. It answers
  whether the gradient changed shape anywhere, with one test, not one per
  band. It sits beside the headline verdict and never alters it, and a
  non-rejection reads *no evidence of a gradient change*, not "no change"
  (`gradient_verdict()`). For AFE it is also computed on the delta-Gamma
  fit, over the Stage 3 × band terms of both parts together (the parts'
  estimates are correlated, so the joint covariance is used).

```{r}
# the full grid: every stage × band term of each model's band scheme
bag_grid <- ss_fits |>
  mutate(rr = map2(fit, bands, \(f, b) rate_ratios(tidy(f), grid_terms_of(b)))) |>
  select(id, dataset, gear, bands, family, rr) |> unnest(rr) |>
  mutate(stage = str_extract(term, "Stage [23]"), band = str_remove(term, ".*dist_band"))
save_tab(bag_grid, "bag_rate_ratio_grid")
bag_grid |> select(id, bands, stage, band, rr, rr_lo, rr_hi, p) |> kable_round(3)

# The Wald test of a model's Stage 3 × band terms (D-091), by fit_wald()
# (r/bag_helpers.R), which labels the fixed effects and their covariance from
# the fit's own design matrix: sdmTMB's vcov() leaves them unlabelled when
# the formula has a smooth, as every BAG model does. `delta = TRUE` tests
# both parts of a delta-Gamma fit together, with their cross-part
# covariance. Terms that cannot be matched give NA, never a test on
# mispaired estimates and variances.
stage3_wald <- function(fit, bands, delta = FALSE) {
  fit_wald(fit, grid_terms_of(bands, stages = 3), parts = if (delta) c(1, 2) else 1)
}

# one row per fit: the headline fit (NB2 for VP, Tweedie for AFE in these
# interim models) and, for AFE, the delta-Gamma fit. A fit that did not
# converge has no readable covariance, so its test is NA rather than read
gradient_test <- bind_rows(
  ss_fits |> transmute(id, dataset, gear, bands, model = family, headline_fit = TRUE,
                       converged = map_lgl(fit, fit_ok), w = map2(fit, bands, stage3_wald)),
  ss_fits |> filter(!map_lgl(fit_dg, is.null)) |>
    transmute(id, dataset, gear, bands, model = "delta_gamma (both parts)", headline_fit = FALSE,
              converged = map_lgl(fit_dg, fit_ok),
              w = map2(fit_dg, bands, \(f, b) stage3_wald(f, b, delta = TRUE)))) |>
  unnest(w) |>
  mutate(across(c(chi2, p), \(x) if_else(converged, x, NA_real_)),
         gradient = gradient_verdict(p)) |>
  arrange(id, desc(headline_fit))
save_tab(gradient_test, "bag_gradient_test")
gradient_test |> select(id, bands, model, converged, chi2, df, p, gradient) |> kable_round(4)
```

The gradient profile: one panel per dataset × gear, the rate ratio of each
band against the 8–15 km ring, relative to Stage 1, with one line per
stage. The dashed line at 1 is no change since Stage 1; a gradient that
changed shape bends away from it, and how it bends says where the change
is.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
profile <- bag_grid |>
  mutate(band = factor(band, intersect(band_order, unique(band)))) |>
  # the panel names the band scheme, since a pooled profile has two points
  # per stage, not four (D-076), and the gradient test's reading
  left_join(gradient_test |> filter(headline_fit) |> transmute(id, gradient, p_grad = p), by = "id") |>
  mutate(panel = paste0(id, " (", bands, "): ", coalesce(gradient, "gradient test not available"),
                        if_else(is.na(p_grad), "", sprintf(", p = %.3f", p_grad))))
p <- ggplot(profile, aes(band, rr, colour = stage, group = stage)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = rr_lo, ymax = rr_hi), size = 0.25, position = position_dodge(0.3)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = stage_cols) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 2, scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(55)) +
  labs(x = "distance band (against the 8–15 km ring)", y = "rate ratio since Stage 1 (log scale)",
       colour = NULL, title = "BAG gradient profile: every stage × band term (D-091)",
       subtitle = "95% CIs; panel titles give the Wald test of all Stage 3 × band terms")
save_fig(p, "bag_gradient_profile", height = 9)
p
```

### Without the cells ever inside a safety zone

Caveat 17: from installation, a foundation's 500 m zone covers most of its
cell, so part of any Stage 3 fall in the `inside` band is mandated. This
refit drops every cell with any area in an active zone in any month.

```{r}
length(zone_cells)
bag_rr_nozone <- ss_sets |>
  mutate(rr = map2(spec_nozone, terms, \(s, tm) rate_ratios(tidy(get_fit(s)), tm))) |>
  select(id, rr) |> unnest(rr)
save_tab(bag_rr_nozone, "bag_rate_ratios_no_zone_cells")
bag_rr_nozone |> select(id, term, rr, rr_lo, rr_hi) |> kable_round(3)
```
